properties.description: Incremental watermark-based ingestion of transactions from on-prem SQL Server to ADLS Gen2 bronze container as Parquet.

activities.name: lkp_get_watermark
activities.description: Read the last successful watermark from pipeline_watermarks table.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT last_watermark_value FROM dbo.pipeline_watermarks WHERE pipeline_name = 'pl_ingest_transactions'

activities.name: lkp_get_max_date
activities.description: Read the maximum InvoiceDate from source — this becomes the new watermark on success.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT MAX(invoice_date) AS max_invoice_date FROM dbo.transactions

activities.name: copy_incremental_transactions
activities.description: Copy only rows where invoice_date > last watermark. Output: Parquet in bronze/transactions/year=YYYY/month=MM/.

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT invoice_no, stock_code, description, quantity, invoice_date, unit_price, customer_id, country FROM dbo.transactions WHERE invoice_date > '@{activity('lkp_get_watermark').output.firstRow.last_watermark_value}'

activities.name: sp_update_watermark
activities.description: Update the watermark to the max invoice_date from this run. Only runs on successful copy.
